Chiari Malformation Update: Surgical Techniques and Outcomes

Global Neurosciences Institute Chiari Support Group · September 2, 2026

Presented by Christopher A. Rivas

About this talk

On September 2, 2026, I presented some of the Chiari malformation research we are doing at the Global Neurosciences Institute (GNI) to GNI's Chiari Support Group, an audience of patients and families.

Because this was a talk for patients and families, I started with an introduction to research itself: what it is, how we conduct it, and how we draw conclusions. The talk then moves through traditional and refined surgical approaches, compares surgical outcomes, and looks ahead to future research. It closes with a Q&A, where Dr. Erol Veznedaroglu helped answer questions.
